tldr:
For the causal marginal median contrast under randomized assignment and a shared unknown outcome-dependent recording function, the finite-sample honest expected-length frontier is
\[
H(n,q,r)\asymp\min\left\{1,n^{-1/2}+r\min\{1,(nq)^{-2/5},(nqr)^{-1/2}\}\right\}.
\]
The validation contribution is defined to be zero at \(r=0\). One total observable interval, independent of the assessment radius, attains this profile simultaneously, and \(\mathcal A(n,q)\asymp1\) without a logarithmic penalty. Cohort-scale length holds exactly when \(r_n=O(\max\{n^{-1/2},q_n,n^{-1/10}q_n^{2/5}\})\). Exact original-record likelihoods and the restricted canonical gradient explain the calibration, while finite kernel, pilot and outward-CDF arguments prove coverage and unconditional length. This is a prospective precision benchmark for the median BMI-loss contrast of Sun--Haneuse--Levis and coauthors, on a strictly narrower randomized common-recording compact class; it does not reanalyze their observational data.
gap: Sun and coauthors establish double-sampling quantile asymptotics under positive validation and discuss nonparametric rate questions. Levis and coauthors defer efficient influence functions under proper full-data restrictions. Neither verified theorem supplies a globally finite honest expected-length frontier near equality under a common unknown recording function as recovery vanishes. The benchmark adds explicit global density and recording envelopes beyond Sun's quantile regularity. The accessible 2019 Miao completeness and restricted-odds-ratio theorems do not cover this unrestricted selection model; the final Miao, Yang and Zhang theorem texts remain externally unverifiable.
fill: The kernel determines \(H\), \(\mathcal A\), a total radius-blind honest interval and the exact cohort-scale resource sequences. It retains original-record likelihoods, legal smooth same-parent alternatives, and a finite outward CDF inversion requirement. No candidate upper order or bounded-adaptation conclusion is imposed as an assumption. Identification is supporting already-known substrate. Novelty rests on the frontier and observable honest calibration within the declared complete class, not on imposing compact envelopes or on the gradient calculation alone.
